mobile.schedules.empty.body: Ask an agent in chat to do something on a regular basis and it will appear here. Wakes fire a prompt into a conversation at a time; monitors watch one thing and report what changes.
mobile.schedules.empty.title: Nothing is armed
mobile.schedules.gone.monitors: Gone — its conversation is no longer on this machine, so nothing checks
mobile.schedules.gone.wakes: Gone — its conversation is no longer on this machine, so nothing fires
mobile.schedules.parked.monitors: Parked — monitors resume when its conversation runs again
mobile.schedules.parked.wakes: Parked — wakes resume after its next turn
mobile.schedules.read_error.monitors: The monitors on this machine could not be read.
mobile.schedules.read_error.wakes: The wakes on this machine could not be read.
mobile.schedules.read_unreachable: We couldn't read this machine's schedules just now.
mobile.schedules.show_more.monitors: {hidden, plural, one {Show # more monitor} other {Show # more monitors}}
mobile.schedules.show_more.wakes: {hidden, plural, one {Show # more wake} other {Show # more wakes}}
mobile.schedules.supervisor.not_running: The wake supervisor is installed but not running, so the wakes below will not fire.
mobile.schedules.supervisor.unsupported: Wakes are not supervised on this platform yet, so the wakes below only fire while a conversation is running.
mobile.schedules.supervisor.unverifiable: Nothing supervises the wakes below, so they only fire while their conversation is running.
